When Liberty has the ball (big plays on the ground): Liberty’s offense turns 11.0% of its runs into explosive gains, and New Mexico State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 8.8% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).

When New Mexico State has the ball (third down): New Mexico State’s offense converts 34.3% of its third downs, and Liberty’s defense allows opponents to convert 28.5% of their third downs (FBS average 39.6%).
